svg.text: the doubt: two poisons in quick succession
hold and drive (hold12): scan, and drive while the hold is up
giving up, and turning from poison ahead
each poison pulls q down ~0.8 V; it recovers through rq over ~1.5 s; food lifts it. Below ~0.65 V, the
first transistor lets go, the second pulls w down: a falling edge that flips the latch.
u sags once the free eye has seen nothing for a few seconds: the PNP feeds the hold, both thrusters drive straight.
